 IA No. 69831/2018 - CONDONATION OF DELAY IN FILING & IA No.
 69834/2018 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING C/C OF THE IMPUGNED JUDGMENT
Date : 17-03-2023 These matters were called on for hearing today.
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.R. SHAH  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE C.T. RAVIKUMAR

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Ashwani Kumar, AOR  Mr. Anshay Dhatwalia, Adv.
 For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) Diary No(s). 16667/2018:
It is the case on behalf of the petitioner that, in the present case, the possession of the land(s) in question has already been taken over on 21.03.2007.
However thereafter and despite the above, relying upon the decision of this Court in the case of Pune Municipal Corporation and Another vs. Harakchand Misirimal Solanki and Others reported in (2014) 3 SCC 183, the High Court has allowed the writ petition and has declared that the acquisition with respect to the land in question is Delhi Development Authority vs Meer Singh on 17 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130983374/
1 deemed to have been lapsed under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
Issue notice on the application for condonation of delay as well as on the Special Leave Petition, for final disposal returnable on 28.04.2023.
